messages.subject: oom-killer with Shiny
parts:
I am using Shiny Server and we are doing a load test to see whether simultaneous users can access and use the system without any degradation in performance. We are finding tremendous problems with the load test and the log shows it is related to memory and the oom-killer is killing the R process. The snippet from the log is below.


[root@888167-RSHNWB1 ~]# grep -i kill /var/log/messages

Sep 27 09:50:39 888167-RSHNWB1 kernel: R invoked oom-killer: gfp_mask=0x280da, order=0, oom_score_adj=0

Sep 27 09:50:39 888167-RSHNWB1 kernel: [<ffffffff81184d0e>] oom_kill_process+0x24e/0x3c0

Sep 27 09:50:39 888167-RSHNWB1 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 66661 (R) score 929 or sacrifice child

Sep 27 09:50:39 888167-RSHNWB1 kernel: Killed process 66661 (R) total-vm:32883600kB, anon-rss:30609396kB, file-rss:0kB, shmem-rss:0kB

[root@888167-RSHNWB1 ~]#


My app has a really small footprint. No data are loaded at all. But, the user has the option to load data files. I have modified the server.R code to allow for files up to 50MG via the code below:


options(shiny.maxRequestSize=50*1024^2) # 50 mg limit on file upload


But, the server has 26 gigs available (36 gigs total).


Has anyone experienced this same issue with Shiny server and can offer insight/suggestions on how I might resolve the problem?


Harold
